summary.current_focus: Qwen full-serving correctness and benchmark-model progress
summary.recent_pattern: Recent slices stayed mostly on Qwen numeric/runtime fixes, but three of the latest twelve commits still went to reporting or guardrail details.
summary.reflection: Current benchmark model evidence moved from Qwen numeric-boundary fixes into resource-backed runner execution: workload filtering, batch materialization, worker sizing, MPK bounded execution, and decode-step evidence. The next target is full paper-row execution, not another artifact-specific reporting pass.
summary.test_strategy: Keep one broad viewer contract check plus focused generator and policy tests. Avoid sparse row-by-row tests for every imported artifact; prefer large integrated tests that exercise benchmark-model execution, viewer import, and report validation together.

work_focus.notes: Runtime evidence remains the largest share, but reporting and guardrail slices are still close enough to require discipline. Next work should favor actual Qwen paper-row execution over new artifact-specific assertions.
